about: What the chatbot skill's run scripts (`.claude/skills/owa-enhance-chatbot/scripts/`) read off the window in this language: each `patterns` entry is a regular-expression source matched beside its English (`extra-work/language-packages.mjs`, `genRunWordSource`); `templateFill` finishes a fill-in question the way a person would; `bookNames` reads a verse button back to English.
